title: Divergence identity d(b·p_I^#γ) = (b·div g∘p_I)·dx^I + db∧p_I^#γ, with bounds (parent step 9)
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (I : Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) (θ : Covector (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (b : Euclid P → ℝ), StrictMono I → (∀ v : Fin (m + 1) → Euclid P, θ v = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k j => v j (I k))) → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) b → HasCompactSupport b → ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ g : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → ∃ (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (ζ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)), IsTestForm η ∧ IsTestForm ζ ∧ tsupport η ⊆ tsupport b ∧ tsupport ζ ⊆ tsupport b ∧ (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (η x) ≤ K) ∧ (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (ζ x) ≤ K) ∧ ∀ x, exteriorDerivative η x = (b x * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ g (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun k => x (I k)))).toLinearMap) • θ + ζ x
